prompt_head:
Job: Solutions Architect at Smartsheet
<requirements>
- (required) 3 years relevant work experience or equivalent combination of relevant work experience and ed

paragraphs.text: I'm applying for the Solutions Architect role at Smartsheet. The posting highlights the need to independently design, build, and ship production‑grade full‑stack applications, which aligns with my work as a systems architect.

I built tycodes.app, an AI demo generator that turns a business URL into a live, shoppable 3D demo in roughly one minute. It runs on Cloudflare Workers with Vite, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind, and uses a Hono Worker that calls OpenAI for pricing models. I also architected linkme‑intops, a React‑TypeScript CRM module on Cloudflare Workers that gives high‑value subscription accounts a dedicated interface.
I have not yet performed regular travel beyond occasional client visits. I will schedule travel as needed and keep my driving record clean to meet the travel requirement.
I would welcome a conversation to discuss how my experience fits Smartsheet's needs.
